{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  -- Start from the model's direct components
  SELECT 
    mb.component_id AS component_id,
    mb.qty AS total_qty
  FROM company_model cm
  JOIN model_bom mb ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
  WHERE cm.model_code = 'VI6-140GRY36-0521'
    AND mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
    AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recurse into assembly components
  SELECT 
    cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
    bt.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
  FROM bom_tree bt
  JOIN component_bom cb ON bt.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
  WHERE cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bt.component_id) AS distinct_parts
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN component c ON bt.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.is_assembly = FALSE"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  -- Start from the model's direct components
  SELECT 
    mb.component_id,
    mb.qty AS total_qty
  FROM company_model cm
  JOIN model_bom mb ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
  WHERE cm.model_code = 'TE5-180WHT72-0072'
    AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recurse into assembly components
  SELECT 
    cb.child_component_id,
    bt.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
  FROM bom_tree bt
  JOIN component_bom cb ON bt.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
  WHERE bt.component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE is_assembly = true)
    AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(bt.total_qty * c.unit_cost), 2) AS total_parts_cost
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN component c ON bt.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.is_assembly = false"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the bundle SKU
bundle AS (
  SELECT sku_id, sku_code FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_code = 'BDL-UK-0265'
),
-- Get item SKUs in the bundle with their quantities
bundle_items AS (
  SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_item_qty
  FROM bundle_item bi
  JOIN bundle b ON bi.bundle_sku_id = b.sku_id
),
-- Get models for each item SKU with quantities
item_models AS (
  SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.bundle_item_qty, sm.model_id, sm.qty AS model_qty
  FROM bundle_items bi
  JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Get components for each model with quantities (model BOM)
model_components AS (
  SELECT im.item_sku_id, im.bundle_item_qty, im.model_id, im.model_qty,
         mb.component_id, mb.qty AS component_qty
  FROM item_models im
  JOIN model_bom mb ON im.model_id = mb.model_id
  WHERE mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- Recursively explode component BOMs
component_tree AS (
  -- Base: components from model BOM
  SELECT mc.item_sku_id, mc.bundle_item_qty, mc.model_id, mc.model_qty,
         mc.component_id, mc.component_qty AS base_qty,
         mc.component_qty AS total_qty,
         1 AS level
  FROM model_components mc
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recursive: child components from component BOM
  SELECT ct.item_sku_id, ct.bundle_item_qty, ct.model_id, ct.model_qty,
         cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
         cb.qty AS base_qty,
         ct.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty,
         ct.level + 1 AS level
  FROM component_tree ct
  JOIN component_bom cb ON ct.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
  WHERE cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
),
-- Find the target part
target_part AS (
  SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'TAB-960-WAL-02843'
)
-- Sum total quantity of target part across all paths
SELECT SUM(ct.total_qty * ct.bundle_item_qty * ct.model_qty) AS total_units
FROM component_tree ct
JOIN target_part tp ON ct.component_id = tp.component_id
JOIN component c ON ct.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.is_assembly = false"}

    FROM bundle_items bi

    SELECT im.item_sku_id, im.bundle_qty, im.model_id, im.model_qty,

    WHERE mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)

    -- Base: all components from model_bom

           mc.component_id, mc.component_qty as direct_qty, mc.total_qty,

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  -- Find the component_id for TAB-623-OAK-01932
  SELECT c.component_id AS target_id FROM component c WHERE c.component_code = 'TAB-623-OAK-01932'
),
-- Recursive: find all assemblies that directly or indirectly contain the target component
assembly_contains AS (
  -- Direct: parent assemblies that have target as child in component_bom
  SELECT cb.parent_component_id AS assembly_id
  FROM component_bom cb
  JOIN bom_tree bt ON cb.child_component_id = bt.target_id
  WHERE cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
  
  UNION
  
  -- Recursive: parent assemblies of any assembly that contains the target
  SELECT cb.parent_component_id
  FROM component_bom cb
  JOIN assembly_contains ac ON cb.child_component_id = ac.assembly_id
  WHERE cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),
-- All components that are the target itself or any containing assembly
all_matching_components AS (
  SELECT target_id AS component_id FROM bom_tree
  UNION
  SELECT assembly_id FROM assembly_contains
)
-- Count distinct company models that use any of these components in current model_bom
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mb.model_id) AS model_count
FROM model_bom mb
JOIN all_matching_components amc ON mb.component_id = amc.component_id
WHERE mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
"}

    -- Base case: direct component usage in assemblies
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id AS top_assembly_id,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM component_bom cb
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: drill down into sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        bh.top_assembly_id,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        bh.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_hierarchy bh
    JOIN component_bom cb ON bh.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
      AND bh.component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE is_assembly = true)
),

target_component AS (
    SELECT component_id 
    FROM component 
    WHERE component_code = 'CAB-566-GRY-00609'
),
-- Find all assemblies (including top-level models) that contain the target component
assemblies_with_target AS (
    -- Target is directly in an assembly
    SELECT DISTINCT parent_component_id AS assembly_id
    FROM component_bom
    WHERE child_component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_component)
      AND valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION
    
    -- Target is nested in an assembly via hierarchy
    SELECT DISTINCT top_assembly_id AS assembly_id
    FROM bom_hierarchy
    WHERE component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_component)
),
-- Also include if the target is itself a top-level component in a model
models_with_target AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mb.model_id
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_component)

    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN store_orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
),
-- Explode bundles: get individual item SKUs with their quantities
exploded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.sku_id,
        ol.sku_code,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_qty AS sku_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expanded to their item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        sk.sku_code,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_qty * bi.qty AS sku_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ol.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON bi.item_sku_id = sk.sku_id
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = true
),
-- Map SKUs to models
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_no,
        es.sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_per_sku_qty,
        es.order_date,
        es.sku_qty * sm.qty AS total_model_qty
    FROM exploded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Get model BOM components with validity
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.line_no,
        sm.total_model_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS component_per_model_qty,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.total_model_qty * mb.qty AS total_component_qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)

-- Recursive CTE to explode component BOMs
recursive_bom AS (
    -- Base: start with model components
    SELECT 
        mc.order_id,
        mc.line_no,
        mc.component_id,
        mc.total_component_qty AS qty,
        mc.order_date,
        1 AS level
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        rb.order_id,
        rb.line_no,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        rb.qty * cb.qty AS qty,
        rb.order_date,
        rb.level + 1
    FROM recursive_bom rb
    JOIN component_bom cb ON rb.component_id = cb.parent_component_id

    JOIN component c ON rb.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
)
